description: Task family: pinch, pinch_sinusoid, or downwards_rotate.
Experiment queue the run belongs to.
Unique training run; matches the checkpoint directory under logs/. Join key to the run_parameters_*.csv tables.
Observation/sensor bundle variant (the compared policy axis): none, baseline, proprio.target, proprio.delta, force.magnitude.
Raw run suffix from the queue (includes bundle and seed tag).
Policy action selection during eval: det = deterministic (distribution mean). All rows here are det.
Evaluation rollout index 0..99 (100 rollouts per run). Each index is a distinct env reset / initial condition; the eval RNG stream is shared across runs for comparability.

Number of steps in the episode where the env success condition held (sum of the per-step reward/success_per_step channel; equals the final success_count). This is the raw statistic to build success-vs-threshold curves.
Total steps in the rollout (80 for pinch/pinch_sinusoid, 120 for downwards_rotate).
Training queue outcome for the run: ok or failed. One force.magnitude run (queue ...142357, seed 7) is failed; retained for completeness.

mujoco_playground commit used to evaluate this run. 3682863 (current HEAD) for all runs whose training-time observation spec matches HEAD. 0ac79f5 for the 6 force.magnitude runs from queues 195014 and 133237, whose force observation (fingertip_forces=2, state=19) predates commit 0e297c3 that expanded it (fingertip_forces=4, state=21); evaluated against their training-time code via an isolated git worktree.
Lower bound of the goal-rotation band the policy was evaluated under (downwards_rotate only; empty for pinch tasks). The downwards success eval uses 60 deg.

Upper bound of the goal-rotation band (downwards_rotate only; 120 deg, the top of the 0-120 deg training range). The 120-150 deg out-of-distribution study is a detailed dataset, not part of this success file.

Actual target rotation magnitude sampled for this rollout (downwards_rotate only), uniform in [target_min_deg, target_max_deg]. Lets you bin success by difficulty within the band. Empty for pinch tasks.
